facts.text: I quit a soul-sucking corporate career that I was stuck in.
I felt stuck going from a corporate career to starting something I was passionate about.
I was able to grow my business to seven figures.
I was nervous about making YouTube videos.
I could not imagine making the YouTube video that I am making now.
My business depends on me making videos and talking to clients.
I was shy and nervous about putting myself out there.
I have been doing the exercise of forming identity and world view statements for the past four years.
I went from being stuck in a corporate career to believing the job was the only way to make money.
I changed my belief to that the world is abundant and things are coming to me in abundance.
I did not know how I would get my financial freedom.
I looked at longer term what I wanted and what would make my life a vacation.
I had the idea to start making YouTube videos.
I started making YouTube videos without knowing I wanted to do coaching.
I thought I might sell notebooks, journals, planners, or merch.
Someone reached out to me for coaching.
That coaching outreach changed my paradigm forever.
I wanted freedom for my nine to five job.
I only needed to earn 5K a month to replace what I was getting paid in my dead end engineering career.
I later had six figure months.
I wanted to earn 5K a month and later my business was doing six figure months.
